content.text: Hath this been in your days,
and he hath the cheek teeth
laid my fig tree for a barking
the like, neither shall be any more
They shall run to and fro

content: to me with all your heart,

content.text: therewith: and I will no more make
but I will remove far off
and he will cause to come down
and none else: and my people
And it shall come to pass afterward,

content: And it shall come to pass,

content.text: Yea, and what have ye to do with me, O Tyre,
that ye might remove them far
the Lord shall be brought down
And it shall come to pass in that day,
Even I the Lord that dwelleth in Zion
